title: The tensor product of two finitely presented algebras is finitely presented (Stacks 00F4, 05G5)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A$, $A'$ commutative $R$-algebras of finite presentation over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Then the $R$-algebra $A\otimes_RA'$ (with multiplication $(a\otimes a')(b\otimes b')=ab\otimes a'b'$ and structure map $r\mapsto r\otimes1=1\otimes r$) is of finite presentation over $R$. (Proof in the source: by base change (Stacks 05G5 (4)) the ring map $A\to A\otimes_RA'$ is of finite presentation, and the composition $R\to A\to A\otimes_RA'$ of ring maps of finite presentation is of finite presentation (Stacks 00F4 (2)).)
